evidenceBasis: Draft built from docs/research/resistance-training-evidence.md (2026-09-23): the ACSM 2026 and 2009 position stands plus systematic reviews and meta-analyses. Each value is cited to a source with a locator and a certainty grade, or marked as an owner decision where the literature gives no number. Evidence-based, not clinician-reviewed. Exercise inclusion also cites training trials from docs/research/exercise-evidence.json where one exists. Approved by the automated evidence gate (ADR-014); no person signs it.
